# dodopayments_product_collection (List Resource)

Finds product collections to import with `terraform query`.

-> List resources need Terraform 1.14 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Run "terraform query -generate-config-out=generated.tf" to write a resource block and an import block for each object.
list "dodopayments_product_collection" "all" {
  provider         = dodopayments
  include_resource = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `archived` (Boolean) List archived collections.
- `brand_id` (String) Filter by Brand id.
- `locale` (String) Shows the translated name, description and unit of the catalog entities in this
locale. The value must be a code from `GET /locales`, for example `fr`.
A field with no translation, an unknown code, or no code shows the base text.

Do not send a text from a localized response back in a create or update request.
The base text then changes to the translated text.
